Subject: Feedback on Recent Stay - Exceptional Service

Dear Hotel Manager,

I am writing to express my sincere appreciation for the exceptional service I received during my recent stay at your hotel. From the moment I arrived until my departure, the staff went above and beyond to ensure my comfort and satisfaction.

I would like to specifically highlight the efforts of [Employee Name 1] at the front desk, who was incredibly welcoming and efficient during check-in, and [Employee Name 2] in the restaurant, whose attentive service and friendly demeanor made my dining experience truly memorable. Their professionalism and warmth significantly contributed to making my visit a pleasant one.

Given the high standard of hospitality I experienced, I would not hesitate to recommend your hotel to my peers and colleagues. I look forward to returning in the future.

Sincerely,

[Your Name]
[Your Contact Information]
